## What should be documented

The topic, and what a reader would be able to do afterwards that they
cannot do now.

## Where it belongs

`README.md` has the six directories and what each holds.

- [ ] Fits an existing directory: <!-- which -->
- [ ] Does not fit — which means either stretching one of the six or
      adding a seventh. Both are real decisions; say which you think it
      is and why.

## Does it already exist elsewhere?

Much of this project's reasoning currently lives in commit messages, in
each repository's `CLAUDE.md`, or in the code's own comments. If this
document would move something rather than create it, say where it is
now — and remember that a fact copied into a second place is a fact that
will eventually disagree with itself. Linking is usually better.

## Can the claims be checked?

A document whose statements cannot be verified goes stale without
anyone noticing. If the subject does not lend itself to a command or a
measurement, say so — it may still be worth writing, but it should be
written knowing that.
